'''Naalol''' was a sparsely-inhabited backwater [[Planet/Legends|planet]], third in the [[Naalol system/Legends|Naalol system]], with a small [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] garrison. It was the [[Oquan]] headquarters. It had high peaks, winding ridges, with small [[City/Legends|towns]] in the [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], and larger cities in the plains below.
